# redis-cluster-kubernetes-operator

> Kubernetes operator that creates and manages Redis Cluster (sharded, hash slots) from a RedisCluster custom resource: topology, failover, resharding, blue/green pod rollouts and backups. Namespace-scoped. Beta: Redis 8.6 on Kubernetes 1.33.

Agents setting up or checking a cluster should follow the skills; they use the scripts below and report JSON results.

## Agent skills

- [Set up the operator and a cluster](skills/redis-cluster-setup/SKILL.md): confirm target, preflight, install, size, create, verify
- [Health check](skills/redis-cluster-health/SKILL.md): read-only report for every RedisCluster

## Scripts

- [scripts/preflight.sh](scripts/preflight.sh): is this Kubernetes cluster ready for the operator (`--json`)
- [scripts/verify-cluster.sh](scripts/verify-cluster.sh): does a RedisCluster serve traffic (`--json`)

## Docs

- [Sizing](docs/sizing.md): requirements to primaries, replicas, maxmemory, CPU and memory
